role_spread: [Pre-Sales Consultant, Inside Sales Executive] higher: logical, attention_span / lower: bodily, extraversion

nuances: [economics] The band understates the top of this profession more than any other in the sector, because a large share of sales pay is variable. role_spread: [Compensation & Benefits Analyst, HR Operations Executive] higher: logical, attention_span, conscientiousness / lower: extraversion, emotional_intelligence

one_liner: Moves, stores and dispatches goods so orders actually arrive.
job_roles: Warehouse Associate | Inventory Assistant | Dispatch Executive | Forklift Operator (warehouse) | Last-Mile Delivery Executive | Loading Supervisor | Packing & Fulfilment Associate
self_emp_route: Owning a delivery vehicle and contracting to a logistics firm, or a small local transport business.
ai_reason: Physical handling of goods in unstructured spaces. Warehouse automation is real but capital-intensive and concentrated in the largest facilities; most Indian warehousing is manual.
path_to_entry: class_10: Class 10 is enough for most entry roles -> certificate: LSC skill certification, or a forklift or material-handling licence -> employment: E-commerce fulfilment centres, 3PL warehouses, retail distribution, quick-commerce dark stores -> progression: Team lead, then shift and warehouse operations — the ladder is real and internal
review_reason: SELF-EMPLOYMENT CEILING OWED. Employed mid-career is 4.75 lakh and owning a vehicle and contracting to a logistics firm is a common step up, but no reliable Indian figure exists for what an owner-driver clears after EMI and fuel.
nuances: [professional_sector] This is the BASE of the logistics pyramid, listed beside Supply Chain & Logistics Manager at its apex — the same treatment Mason gets beside Civil Engineer. Industry employment figures count this layer; profession size does not follow from them.

self_emp_route: Own retail shop or a brand franchise. Retail experience translates directly into running a store, which is the most common small business in India.
ai_reason: Billing and stock counting are automatable and self-checkout exists. Persuading someone in a shop, handling a complaint and physically running a floor are not.
role_spread: [Visual Merchandiser] higher: spatial, openness / lower: extraversion
path_to_entry: class_12: Class 12 in any stream; some roles take class 10 -> certificate: RASCI retail skill certification, or employer-run induction training -> employment: Organised retail chains, malls, brand stores, supermarkets, quick-commerce stores -> progression: Section, then store operations — retail promotes from the floor more than most sectors
nuances: [professional_sector] The base of the retail pyramid, and a formal organised-sector job — a store associate has an employer, a salary slip and a shift roster. It is included for the same reason as the construction trades: the layer that employs the most people should not be invisible because it sits at the bottom of a pyramid.

one_liner: Decides what a product should do next, and why.

It is a lateral destination reached after a few years in engineering, design, analytics or sales, which is why years_to_qualify is 5 rather than 3. A student should read it as a second job, not a first one.

one_liner: Starts and runs a business — and carries the risk of it.
job_roles: Founder | Small Business Owner | Franchise Owner | D2C Brand Owner | Self-Employed Trader / Distributor | Co-Founder (operations)
industrial_sectors: MEPSC | RASCI | FICSI | AMHSSC | THSC | IT-ITES | LSC
self_emp_route: This profession IS self-employment; there is no employed version of it. The ceiling is genuinely unbounded upward and the floor is zero, which is why no ceiling figure is claimed.
ai_reason: Not meaningfully exposed as a whole, because the work is deciding what to do with incomplete information and living with the consequence. Individual tasks inside a small business are heavily automatable, which mostly makes one person able to run more.
path_to_entry: any_stage: No qualification exists and none is required — this is the only profession in the taxonomy you cannot be admitted to -> capability: Usually a trade, craft, technical or sales skill first; the business is built on top of something you can already do -> capital: Own savings, family capital, or a government scheme — MUDRA, PMEGP, Stand-Up India -> operation: Registration, GST, and the discipline of running it
review_reason: The economics are unlike anything else in the dataset: outcomes are extremely dispersed, survivorship bias is severe in every available source, and a range is close to meaningless. Decide whether to show numbers at all for this record, or present it with the range suppressed and the risk stated instead. Also decide whether it should surface for school-age users at all, or only for college and working-age ones.
nuances: [profession] This record strains the profession test and is included deliberately. Interest alignment is clear and the sector is named for it, but the SKILL SET is not separate — running a business is sales, operations and finance combined. It earns its place as the destination those skills combine into, and because leaving it out would make the sector's own name false. || [economics] The only record in the taxonomy whose early_earnings band starts at zero, and that is not a formatting artefact. A founder can earn nothing for years. Every other profession here pays from the first month. || [economics] economics.distribution is 'power_law', which is a statement that the range and the midpoint should not be read as a typical income. Outcomes are extremely dispersed and survivorship bias is severe in every available source. Most new businesses do not reach a stable income at all. The compensation filter does not fire on a power_law record, because deleting a profession on the strength of a number the record itself calls meaningless would be worse than showing it. This record was the FIRST to raise the problem, in Sector 5, and it took five more sectors independently asking for the same exception before the schema was changed.

one_liner: Drives goods and people for a living under a commercial licence - trucks, buses, ambulances.
job_roles: Heavy Vehicle Driver | Truck Driver | Bus Driver | State Transport Driver | Delivery Van Driver | Ambulance Driver | School Bus Driver | Tanker & Hazardous Goods Driver | Owner-Driver | Driving Instructor
self_emp_route: Owning a truck, van or bus and running it - the standard route above a driver's wage in Indian road transport. It is a leveraged small business: the EMI, fuel, maintenance and idle days all sit with the owner, and it can go badly wrong.
ai_reason: Very low exposure today and the largest long-horizon question of any base-layer profession in this dataset. Driving is physical control of a vehicle in unstructured traffic and nothing in the generative-AI wave touches it. AUTONOMOUS DRIVING IS THE REAL QUESTION and it is deliberately not scored as exposure here: Indian road conditions, mixed traffic and liability law make it far more distant than in the countries where the technology is being developed, and there is no sourced Indian timeline. A student entering this trade at 20 should know the question exists without being told a date nobody can source.
role_spread: [State Transport Driver, School Bus Driver] higher: conscientiousness, agreeableness, attention_span / lower: openness || [Tanker & Hazardous Goods Driver] higher: conscientiousness, logical, neuroticism / lower: extraversion || [Owner-Driver, Driving Instructor] higher: confidence, logical, verbal / lower: bodily
path_to_entry: class_11_12: None. Most states require class 8 pass for a transport licence; a few require class 10. -> licence: A commercial or transport vehicle licence under the Motor Vehicles Act - a separate endorsement from a private licence, with a higher minimum age and a medical. -> training: A driver training institute, or learning under an experienced driver. Hazardous goods and passenger endorsements need specific training. -> work: Logistics company, a state transport corporation, a bus operator, a school, a hospital, or a fleet. Corporation posts are filled by state recruitment. -> independence: Own the vehicle. This is the route off a wage in Indian road transport, and it is capital and risk rather than promotion.
review_reason: Three gaps. No sourced wage figure for Indian commercial drivers at any level. No figure for what an owner-driver actually clears after EMI, fuel, maintenance and idle days - which is the named route up and the one most likely to be oversold to someone. And a presentation decision this record cannot make: it should be DESCRIBED but arguably never SUGGESTED to a school student, which is the third record to need that distinction after Waste Management & Sanitation Worker and Religious & Ritual Professional.
nuances: [job_roles] APP-BASED RIDE-HAILING AND FOOD DELIVERY ARE DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from this record, and the exclusion is the most important thing on it. Those are platform gig work: no employer, no ladder, no notice period, earnings claims that are routinely inflated in recruitment marketing, and a vehicle EMI that sits with the driver rather than the platform. This record covers LICENSED COMMERCIAL DRIVING - a transport endorsement, an employer, and in the case of a state transport corporation a permanent post with a pension. They are not the same occupation and presenting them as one is how the whole trade comes to look like gig work. || [economics] The employed figure is a driver's wage. Two things sit outside it and both matter more: a state transport corporation post is permanent government employment on a pay scale, and long-haul and hazardous goods driving pays materially above the base-layer trades because India has a documented shortage of licensed heavy vehicle drivers. Neither is sourced here. || [demand_signal] High and structurally so - road freight moves the overwhelming majority of Indian goods and the shortage of licensed heavy vehicle drivers is well documented in the logistics industry. This is demand for a licensed skill, not for gig labour.
